title: Intent
description: An intent under .ai/repo/project/intents/: a statement about reality — what must become true, what must stay true, and the evidence that would settle it — above the milestones that realise it. No status is stored: the stage is derived from the milestones' derived status and satisfaction from the recorded evidence.

id.description: The identity, equal to the file name without `.yaml`: `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`.

title.description: One line naming what must become true.

statement.description: What must become true, as a statement about the repository or its users that is either true or false.

invariants.description: What must stay true while the intent is realised.

satisfaction.description: The criteria that settle the statement, each with the evidence that decides it.

milestones.description: The milestones that realise the intent, by the id of a record under .ai/repo/project/milestones/.

governance.description: The governance a worker on this intent loads: `rule:<id>[@<version>]`, `adr:<identity>`, `claim:<id>` or `file:<path>`.

non_goals.description: What the intent deliberately does not require.

cancelled.description: The intent was abandoned. A fact about what happened, not a status.

superseded_by.description: The intent that replaced this one, by id.

criterion.description: What is observably true when the criterion is met.

evidence.description: What decides it. `test` and `claim` are derived from the evidence ledger; `command` and `deployment` resolve but are not derivable yet, so a criterion of either kind is never counted as met.

ref.description: For `test`, the path of a case or integration test or its `suite:`/`crate:` identity; for `claim`, a claim id of docs/CLAIMS.yaml; for `command`, the command; for `deployment`, a deployment id.
